description: Localização dos Pontos de Acesso da Rede Porto Free-Wifi is a dataset listed in data.gov.pt, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Porto Digital. Geographical location of the Access Points (AP) of the Porto Free-Wifi network in AccessPoint (SmartDataModels) model with identification of the GPS location of each device. Coverage: Porto Digital. The portal shows the English title as "Location of Porto Free-Wifi Network Access Points" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Porto Digital. Its keywords include opendata-porto-digital. The listing shows 1 download or service links in CSV. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://www.opendefinition.org/licenses/cc-zero). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-dados-gov-pt.
